thread: Lina Gomez: Pushing a new iteration of the autoscale panel — main asks: where should the burst hint live, and how do we surface pool priority without crowding the row? Screenshot: https://redwood.design/snap/iter-3.png Raj Patel: Nice! First glance: burst hint feels buried. Maybe move it inline next to the burst toggle as a small help pill? :thinking_face: Amanda Chen: Agree with Raj. Inline pill would be discoverable and would avoid a popover for a11y. But need to check contrast and focus order. Tom K.: If we put it inline, make sure keyboard focus sequence is: min -> max -> burst toggle -> burst pill -> pool picker. Otherwise screen reader users miss it. Lina Gomez: Good point on order. Current DOM puts burst pill after pool picker. I can reflow. Also thinking of changing the pill copy from "Burst (best-effort)" to "Burst — temporary extra GPUs". Thoughts? Amanda Chen: "temporary extra GPUs" is clearer but long. Can we try: "Burst — temporary capacity" (shorter) and have a tooltip with the longer explanation for keyboard users? Raj Patel: +1. Also recommend an aria-describedby on the burst toggle that points to the tooltip text so screen readers get the detail without needing to open the tooltip. Example: aria-describedby="burst-desc-1". design-bot: Accessibility checklist: contrast >= 4.5:1 for pill text, focus indicator visible 3px, tooltip accessible via keyboard, aria-live for dynamic capacity changes flagged as polite. Tom K.: On pool priority: we currently show a gold star badge for "priority" pools. Contrast is low on the badge background. Suggest using a darker outline + a hidden text label for screen readers: ★Priority pool. Amanda Chen: Also the SLO slider label is "Latency SLO" right now. People misread it as an absolute target. Can we reword to "Latency SLO (target)" or add a tiny "Lower is better" hint? Microcopy matters here. Lina Gomez: I can try "Latency target" and add inline hint: "lower is better — rolling 95th". Shorter and less ambiguous. Raj Patel: UX nit: min/max steppers use +/− icons but no aria-label. Add aria-label="increase min" etc. Also stepper keyboard is not trapping on double-tap; make sure up/down arrows increment. design-bot: Regression alert: new DOM order may affect automated E2E tests that query by visible text. Add test guard in Cypress: cy.findByRole('spinbutton', {name: /min/i}). Tom K.: Copy tweak for burst tooltip: current draft: "Burst adds temporary GPU capacity when needed." Suggest: "Burst temporarily adds GPU capacity to handle short spikes. Not guaranteed — subject to pool availability." Clearer for SREs. Amanda Chen: Love that. One more accessibility thought — when burst triggers and we show the ephemeral banner, ensure it's announced: use role="status" aria-live="polite">Burst active: +2 GPUs (best-effort). Lina Gomez: Ok action items: 1) Move burst pill inline next to toggle and shorten copy to "Burst — temporary capacity" with tooltip having expanded copy (Tom's wording). 2) Reorder DOM to put pill before pool picker for keyboard order. 3) Add aria-describedby for burst toggle pointing to tooltip text. 4) Update pool priority badge with sr-only label and darker outline. 5) Change SLO label to "Latency target" + small hint. 6) Add aria-labels to steppers and ensure keyboard increment behavior. 7) Add Cypress guard for spinbutton query. Raj Patel: I'll take 1/2/3. Will push a small CSS tweak for the pill contrast. Amanda Chen: I'll author the copy updates and the hint text. Tom K.: I'll add the aria-hidden/sr-only pattern for the badge and handle the banner announce. Lina Gomez: Cool — aiming for a follow-up mock by EOD Friday. Tagging @design-bot for accessibility recheck once PR is up. :thumbsup: design-bot: Noted — will run a11y audit on the PR and post results.
